brief: c123. The church vane sits on the rod under the cross and goes edge-on to a 1-px sliver whenever the heading passes north, and neither vane is named. Give each VANES[] entry a silhouette that reads at every heading — a weathercock on the church (a cock's body reads from the side and as a blob edge-on), the clock tower's arrow kept but with a tail and a cross-bar of N/S/E/W letters that never foreshortens — and make lookAt() name them with their state ('the weathercock, into a west wind' / 'the vane, idle in the calm').
successLooksLike: probes/vane.mjs extended: at heading north each vane's drawn bounding box is ≥ 4 px wide (was 1); lookAt() over either tower returns a vane name in three wind states; the wide shot at noon shows both vanes legibly.
avoid: Do not move the vanes back into the cache. No R() in the draw. Keep vaneAngle()'s mirror test passing.
